item.title: Rupee rises 22 paise to 89.45 against US dollar in early trade
item.description: MUMBAI: The rupee appreciated 22 paise to 89.45 against the US dollar in early trade on Monday supported by foreign fund inflows and a positive trend in domestic equities. item.title: Contemplated retirement after 2023 World Cup final defeat: Rohit Sharma
item.description: NEW DELHI: In a stunning revelation, former India captain Rohit Sharma said he contemplated retirement after the heartbreaking loss to Australia in the 2023 ODI World Cup final as he “felt that the sport had taken everything out of me.” Under the captaincy of Rohit, the Indian team enjoyed a dream run in that tournament [...]

item.title: Stock markets surge in early trade on foreign fund inflows, firm global trends
item.description: MUMBAI: Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty began Monday’s trade on an optimistic note as investors’ sentiment remained positive amid foreign fund inflows and a rally in global markets. item.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh felicitates Second Lieutenant Arun Khetarpal’s family during ‘Ikkis’ special screening
item.description: NEW DELHI: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh attended a special screening of Agastya Nanda’s upcoming war drama, ‘Ikkis’, in the national capital. item.title: Dense fog engulfs nothern India, air quality remains affected
item.description: NEW DELHI: Several states and cities in the northern part of India were engulfed in dense fog. Delhi/NCR, Uttar Pradesh, Varanasi, and Jaipur woke up to reduced visibility and intense cold. Delhi chokes with toxic smog. Delhi experienced a hard time with low visibility as toxic smog persisted over the city-state early morning on Monday. [...]

item.description: NEW DELHI: Dense fog is affecting airport operations in Northern India, causing potential disruptions to flight schedules.
